description: This CSS file contains style definitions and variables for theme management in a frontend application. It includes styles for light and dark themes, as well as component-specific styles for the main app structure and responsive design aspects.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the app, sets the overall text alignment, background color, and color scheme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the app logo, defines the height and pointer events behavior.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for the app header, which contains layout and styling for the header section.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for styling links in the application with a specific color and transition effect.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the button used to toggle themes, includes styles for positioning and hover effects.
